paper.title_en: LISA Reconstruction Landscape for Metastable Cosmic Strings
paper.abstract_en: We study reconstruction of stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds from metastable cosmic strings with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). In the vacuum-tunneling benchmark, the network decays via zero-temperature nucleation of monopole pairs on the string worldsheet. Initially following cosmic-string scaling, loop production is suppressed after a decay time linked to efficient loop breaking and network collapse. This finite lifetime imprints an infrared tail and a transition toward a stable-string-like high-frequency plateau. Using synthetic LISA data with instrumental noise and unresolved astrophysical foregrounds, we perform Bayesian analysis in the $(Gμ,κ_{\rm CS})$ parameter space. We map detectability, uncertainties, correlations, and localization to distinguish background detection from parameter reconstruction. Reconstruction is governed by lifetime-dependent spectral features in the LISA band. When LISA samples the transition between tail and plateau, data contain amplitude and shape information, enabling recovery of string tension and metastability scale. Posteriors may remain correlated, reflecting an amplitude--lifetime trade-off, yet occupy a small parameter region. By contrast, featureless spectra constrain only limited parameter combinations or become prior dominated. High-SNR plateau-like spectra can retain partial sensitivity to $κ_{\rm CS}$ through residual lifetime dependence even when the transition is not prominent. Finally, we assess sensitivity to Galactic foreground modeling by comparing a flexible template with a reduced tanh template. Our results show where LISA can move beyond detection to probe the lifetime of the underlying string network.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文聚焦于使用LISA对亚稳态宇宙弦的随机引力波背景进行研究，属于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）相关领域。论文提供了详细的理论分析、贝叶斯参数估计方法和未来观测的预测，具有较高的理论深度和方法学严谨性，且内容新颖。
decision.title_zh: 亚稳态宇宙弦的LISA重建图景
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了利用激光干涉空间天线（LISA）对来自亚稳态宇宙弦的随机引力波背景进行重建。在真空隧穿基准情形中，弦网络通过弦世界面上单极对的零温成核而衰变。初始遵循宇宙弦标度律，环的产生在衰变时间后被抑制，这与有效的环断裂和网络坍缩相关。这种有限的寿命在频谱上留下红外尾部，并向类似稳定弦的高频平台过渡。利用包含仪器噪声和未分辨天体物理前景的合成LISA数据，我们在$(G\mu,\kappa_{\rm CS})$参数空间中进行贝叶斯分析。我们描绘了可探测性、不确定性、相关性以及区分背景探测与参数重建的定位。重建受LISA频带中依赖于寿命的谱特征支配。当LISA采样到尾部与平台之间的过渡时，数据包含振幅和形状信息，从而能够恢复弦张力和亚稳态标度。后验可能保持相关，反映振幅—寿命权衡，但占据较小的参数区域。相反，无特征的谱仅约束有限的参数组合，或变得由先验主导。即使过渡不突出，高信噪比的平台状谱仍可通过残余的寿命依赖性保持对$\kappa_{\rm CS}$的部分灵敏度。最后，我们通过比较灵活模板与简化tanh模板来评估对银河系前景建模的灵敏度。我们的结果展示了LISA在何处可以超越探测，进而探测底层弦网络的寿命。
